title: Dependency Commitment Audit: Two-week 'Sprint Poker' Cadence + Auto-Generated Contingencies
creator: Anya Patel
description: Problem: cross-team roadmap launches frequently discover hidden dependencies during cutover weeks, causing scope deferrals and firefighting. Goal: create a lightweight, repeatable two-week cadence ("Sprint Poker") to surface commitments, quantify probabilistic runway risk, and auto-generate contingency lanes (fallthroughs) that owners can accept. Proposed deliverables: 1) a one-click Dependency Commitment form in the PM dashboard that emits an event to a dependency ledger; 2) a 'risk score' computed from lateness history, owner confidence, and effort; 3) auto-generated fallback plans (degraded feature toggles, timeline slip buckets, alternative owners) rendered as quick actions for release managers; 4) Slack/Email escalation templates. Acceptance criteria: dependency form used by >80% of cross-team handoffs for two cycles, average time to acknowledge dependency <48h, and a measurable reduction in last-minute rollback incidents by 30% in next quarter.

2025-02-20 — Decision: MVP will remove optional freeform fields and require selection from controlled taxonomy for risk_tags to improve aggregation. Next: eng to finish backend, design to refine UI microcopy, PM to draft rollout communications and 'Sprint Poker' facilitator guide.
